subject: dsm in R with mark recapture

messages.author: e9ac2709368c5aa3
messages.subject: dsm in R with mark recapture
parts:
Hello, 

I decided to run my DSMs outside of Distance Software to have more flexibility, but when I use the dsm function I get a strange error (below). The dsm package says it supports both ds and ddf objects. Below I use a ddf object and get an error message that only ds objects are supported. I'm confused by this. Is there another package I should be using for mark-recapture models?

killer.io <- ddf(dsmodel=~mcds(key = "hr", formula=~size), mrmodel=~glm(~distance),
                 data=killer14_18, method="io", meta.data=list(width=2000))
dsm.xy <- dsm(count~s(X,Y), killer.io, segdata, obsdata, method="REML")

Error in make.data(response, ddf.obj, segment.data, observation.data,  : 
  Only "ds" models are supported!

Thanks in advance for your advice. 

Deanna Leonard

messages.author: 350dad0a615d36db
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] dsm in R with mark recapture
parts:
Hi Deanna, hi listfolk,

The current version of dsm doesn't support mark-recapture distance
sampling models. This has been on my todo list for a while, and should
be okay to implement mostly but there's some fiddly bits with the
uncertainty I've not had a chance to code up yet. Sorry!

best,
--dave
